name: motion-wobble-tilt
title: Wobble Tilt
description: Chạm vào, nút lắc nghiêng qua lại quanh điểm giữa cạnh dưới như con lật đật rồi đứng yên.

moworks.author: moworks

options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: From rest at the tap (0.5 s): angle = 0.24 × e^(−2.4 t) × sin(9 t) rad (first swing about 9°), pivot at the bottom centre; faded to 0 between 1.5-1.9 s after the tap. Equivalent spring k144 d5.6. Button 130x44 r14. Params: at · amp (0.24 rad) · freq (9 rad/s) · decay (2.4) · pivot (đáy giữa). angle = amp × e^(−decay t) × sin(freq t) about the bottom centre; about a spring k 144, damping 5.6.
